metadataRaw.title: How to QUICKLY Fix a Popping and Clicking Knee
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly get rid of clicking and popping knee sounds.

When it comes to knee clicking and popping, major causes include a buildup of joint stiffness (think arthritis) as well as tightness and weakness in the muscles and tendons that support the knee.

To fix this, this video will go over easy exercises to loosen and strengthen the knee for both quick and long-lasting results.

Each exercise works differently and targets different muscles. To get the best results, go through all of them and use what works best for you.

Watch now and get rid of clicking and popping knee sounds!

Chapters: 
0:00 Intro
0:37 Stretching Exercise 1
3:03 Stretching Exercise 2
5:17 Stretching Exercise 3
6:56 Strengthening Exercise 1
